note: The arm that decided how kg splits the classes, measured rather than assumed: a path whose PARENT is not a directory reports ENOTDIR to kg's fopen and "No such file or directory" from Emacs, because Emacs' loader probes suffixes and answers its own not-found instead of the raw errno -- and it is `file-missing' on both sides. That is why kg splits on EACCES (Emacs' permission-denied, out of scope by 12A Decision 1) rather than on ENOENT. Only the OPERATION is compared here, since the strerror text legitimately differs.
